gallery.alt: A white candy cart with 'Toot Sweet Candy Cart' painted on its front panel, dressed with a cascading peach, pink and gold balloon garland, white flowers, a dried pampas arrangement, a drip cake, doughnuts and lidded sweet jars, outside a white-columned building.

The white candy cart styled for brunch in a sunny garden, with flowers along its canopy and posts, a white, peach and silver balloon garland, a cake and champagne on the counter and 'On Weekends We Brunch' on the front panel.

Close-up of the brunch-styled cart: a strawberry Victoria sponge, a bottle of champagne and flutes, scones, sandwiches, watermelon slices and a vase of flowers above the painted 'On Weekends We Brunch' lettering.
An open white sweet box with sixteen compartments of pick 'n' mix sweets and Ferrero Rocher chocolates, on cupcake-print paper.
A windowed sweet box of pick 'n' mix and Ferrero Rocher chocolates tied with pale-blue ribbon, with a navy 'I Love You' tag and a white tag with a sweet-shaped cut-out.
A windowed sweet box tied with yellow ribbon, with a yellow 'Happy Daddy's Day' tag and a round grey Toot Sweet Candy Cart logo sticker, on cupcake-print paper.
Two windowed sweet boxes tied with pale-blue ribbon, each with navy and white gift tags with sweet-shaped cut-outs.

notes: Logo is the original 1000x1000 transparent PNG from the business's Booked Events listing (the same badge appears as a sticker on the business's own sweet boxes in @CartToot photos), re-encoded as WebP q90 with lossless alpha (mean abs diff 0.63/255 vs the PNG on white). It carries its own solid grey disc, so plate is 'none'.

No vector reconstruction was published: logo_trace.py at --colours 2/3/4/5 gave meanAbsDiff 14.6/16.8/12.6/10.3. The badge's thin white emboss edges around the lettering and line-art cart either vanished (2 colours: white oval ring, wrappers and cart fill lost) or became heavy white halos and speckle (3-5 colours), so the trace was not faithful.

No video exists from allowed public sources (no website, TikTok handle not found, X posts are photo-only; Facebook/Instagram not accessible). The showreel is built from six of the business's own photos as still segments with a gentle push-in.

Photos EZlfPHUWsAUX0Mo and EZlfPFMXsAML0gd were excluded from reel and gallery because their gift tags show private customers' names. The X banner (stock-risk unclear), the 400px X avatar (too low-resolution) and EZwnjm_X0AIRd7r in the gallery (near-duplicate of photo-06; used only as the final reel still) were also left out.
Hero still (tootsweet_cart.jpg) is only 1003x915, so the 1280x720 desktop and 720x1280 mobile reel frames from it are upscaled about 1.3-1.4x and slightly soft.
Photos date from 2020 (X) and the Booked Events listing (2024); current trading status is unverified.

Logo re-traced by the coordinator as a 5-tone layered vector (#a6a6a6 disc, #adadad inner oval, white highlights, #6b6b6b shading, black line art) from a 1x render of the 1000px original; meanAbsDiff 5.59, visually faithful at display sizes (checked at 96px). The shaded illustration is posterised at large zoom.
